class.name: JarBiomeMap
class.brief_description: Places biomes on a volume from a simple climate model.
class.description: Gives every position a climate: a temperature (from [member temperature_noise], lowered by [member temperature_lapse] with height above sea level and, on planets, by [member latitude_effect] towards the poles) and a moisture (from [member moisture_noise]). Each [JarBiome] sits at a point in that climate space; a position belongs to the biomes nearest to its climate, blended smoothly over [member blend], so biome borders follow the climate instead of a grid. Mountains get colder biomes, poles get colder biomes, and two noises are enough for varied, plausible regions. Assign it to [member JarVoxelVolume.population_biome_map]. Everything is evaluated per point on worker threads; changing the map regenerates the population and remeshes.

members.member: The biomes. The first 4 can have their own ground materials in the default terrain shaders.
Distance in climate space over which neighbouring biomes blend. Small values give sharper borders.
Planets: how much colder it gets towards the poles (temperature drop at a pole).
Noise for moisture (-1 dry to 1 wet). Without it, moisture is 0 everywhere.
Planets: the axis through the poles, in the volume's space.
Temperature drop per 100 m above sea level, so mountains get colder biomes.
Noise for temperature (-1 cold to 1 hot), before height and latitude. Without it, temperature only depends on those.
